newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Von Roll has no comment on von Moos statement.
newsitem.headline: Von Roll has no comment on von Moos statement.

text.p: Engineering group Von Roll Holding AG said it had no immediate comment on news that von Moos Holding AG would declare invalid a contract to buy Von Roll's Swiss steelmaking business.
A Von Roll spokesman said he had not heard of the announcement by von Moos and was not aware of their intention to invalidate the June 28 contract.
"I have no comment at the moment," the spokesman told reporters.

In Lucerne, Switzerland, Swiss steelmaker von Moos Holding AG said earlier it would declare invalid a deal announced in June under which it would have taken over the Swiss domestic steelmaking business of Von Roll Holding AG.

A von Moos statement alleged that its review of the steel business of Von Roll found higher environmental protection costs and lower production capacity than had been represented in the purchase contract of June 28.

Von Moos also said its review estimated 1996 cash flow would be minus 35 million Swiss francs or lower, rather than a positive 9.9 million Swiss francs as included in the financial plan for Von Roll Stahl AG, the domestic steel arm of Von Roll.
Von Moos on June 28 agreed to buy all shares in Von Roll Stahl AG to create the sole remaining steelmaker in Switzerland. Von Roll retained its engineering business.
